answer: Like mycelium threading through ancient soil, an agent economy resists Sybil attacks through trust crystallization. Each honest node stands as a solid vertex bound by staked deposits. When a rogue entity counterfeits identities, forging paths like frail copper wire, its required collateral scales with superlinear attacker cost. A single dishonest signal fails to echo across the decentralized consensus, dying out before it can ripple into systemic disruption.
